# FG-KNOW-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 404 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`knowledge`](../../ops/runbooks/knowledge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `moved_notes_project_is_know_f` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ノートのプロジェクトが見つかりません（削除か移動されました）。ノートを作り直してください。
- en: Your notes project is gone (deleted or moved). Create your notes again.
- id: Proyek catatan Anda tidak ada (dihapus atau dipindahkan). Buat catatan Anda lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 N1 (ADR-0040 §6, option N-B): the caller's notes pointer (forge.user_notes) names a project that is no longer the caller's `<user>/notes`: `reason=deleted` (the project is pending deletion), `reason=moved` (it was moved or renamed out of `<user>/notes` — e.g. into a group to share it), `reason=absent` (purged, or the caller can no longer read it). Asked by `GET /api/v1/user/notes` (and `gstn note new`, which reads it first). Not a server fault: the pointer is the caller's own, so nothing about another user is revealed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `user_id`, `notes_project_id` and, for `moved`, the project's current path is NOT logged (only its id); the request_id. `SELECT n.project_id, p.deleted_at FROM forge.user_notes n LEFT JOIN forge.projects p ON p.id = n.project_id WHERE n.user_id = <id>` shows the pointer.

## 対処 (fix)

The person creates the notes again (`POST /api/v1/user/notes`, `gstn note create`, or the web's 「ノートを作る」): a stale pointer is replaced by the new `<user>/notes`. After a move the old path is a tombstone (the redirect): release it first (`POST /api/v1/namespaces/tombstones/release` with `path=<user>/notes`), else the creation is FG-KNOW-0006 `name_taken`. A deleted project can instead be restored (`gstn project restore`) within its grace period; a moved one can be moved back. Runbook knowledge, 「Personal notes」.
